context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase S3 Comms Hub backend fully tested and working. All 27 backend tests pass covering: thread CRUD (DM/group/channel/announcement), message CRUD, edit window enforcement, soft delete, mark-as-read, unread counters, announce endpoint. Frontend login flow has an issue preventing UI verification - the login API works but the frontend form submission does not navigate to dashboard. Main agent should investigate the login flow issue.

backend: GET /api/staffing/comms/threads - returns threads (managers see all, staff see only their threads)
POST /api/staffing/comms/threads kind=dm - creates 2-member DM thread, idempotent
POST /api/staffing/comms/threads kind=channel + role_filter - resolves matching staff
GET /api/staffing/comms/threads/{id} - hydrates members with full_name + primary_role
PATCH /api/staffing/comms/threads/{id} - rename and archive (manager only for non-DMs)
GET /api/staffing/comms/threads/{id}/messages - returns messages ascending, supports before+limit pagination
POST /api/staffing/comms/threads/{id}/messages - empty body returns 400, >5000 chars returns 400
PATCH /api/staffing/comms/threads/{id}/messages/{msg_id} - edit within 15 min for author, manager can edit anytime
POST /api/staffing/comms/announce - resolves audience, creates thread + first message
